# 1 Maccabees Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, 1 Maccabees 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/1MA_009_page_001.jpg

---

**1** And Demetrius heard that Nicanor had fallen and his army in battle, and he sent Bacchides and Alcimus again into the land of Judah a second time, and the right wing of the army with them.

**2** And they went by the road that leads to Gilgal and encamped against Mesaloth, which is in Arbela, and they took it and killed many souls.

**3** In the first month of the one hundred and fifty-second year they encamped against Jerusalem.

**4** And they arose and marched to Berea, with twenty thousand men and two thousand cavalry.

**5** And Judas was encamped at Elasa, and three thousand chosen men with him.

**6** And they saw the multitude of the army, that it was great, and they were greatly afraid, and many slipped away from the camp, until there remained of them no more than eight hundred men.

**7** And Judas saw that his army had slipped away and that the battle pressed him, and he was distressed in heart, for he had no time to gather them.

**8** And he was brought low and said to those remaining: "Let us arise and go up against our adversaries; perhaps we are able to fight them."

**9** And they dissuaded him, saying: "We are not able. But let us save our lives now and return to our brothers, and then we will fight against them; but we are few."

**10** And Judas said: "Far be it from me to do this thing, to flee from them. If our time has come, let us die bravely for our brothers and not leave a reproach against our honor."

**11** And the army moved out of the camp and stood to meet them, and the cavalry was divided into two parts, and the slingers and the archers went before the army, and all the mighty men in the front of the battle.

**12** But Bacchides was on the right wing, and the phalanx drew near from both sides and they blew the trumpets.

**13** And the men with Judas also blew their trumpets, and the earth shook from the noise of the armies, and the battle was joined from morning until evening.

**14** And Judas saw that Bacchides and the strength of his army were on the right side, and all the stout-hearted ones gathered with him.

**15** And the right wing was crushed by them, and he pursued after them unto the mountain of Azotus.

**16** And those on the left wing saw that the right wing was crushed, and they turned upon the footsteps of Judas and of those with him from behind.

**17** And the battle was fierce, and many on both sides fell wounded.

**18** And Judas fell, and the rest fled.

**19** And Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother and buried him in the tomb of his fathers at Modein.

**20** And they wept for him, and all Israel made great lamentation for him and mourned many days and said:

**21** "How is the mighty one fallen, the savior of Israel!"

**22** And the rest of the acts of Judas, and his wars and his valiant deeds that he did, and his greatness — they have not been written, for they were very many.

**23** And it came to pass after the death of Judas that the lawless ones put out their heads in all the borders of Israel, and all those who worked iniquity rose up.

**24** In those days a very great famine came, and the land went over to their side with them.

**25** And Bacchides chose the godless men and appointed them lords of the land.

**26** And they sought and searched for the friends of Judas and brought them to Bacchides, and he avenged himself on them and did evil things to them.

**27** And there was a great tribulation in Israel, such as had not been since the day when a prophet ceased to appear to them.

**28** And all the friends of Judas were gathered and said to Jonathan:

**29** "Since your brother Judas died, there is no man like him to go out against our enemies and Bacchides and against those who hate us, the enemies of our nation.

**30** Now therefore we have chosen you today to be our ruler and leader in his place, to fight our battles."

**31** And Jonathan took upon himself the leadership at that time and rose up in the place of his brother Judas.

**32** And Bacchides knew it and sought to kill him.

**33** And Jonathan and Simon his brother and all those with him knew it, and they fled into the wilderness of Tekoa and encamped by the water of the pool of Asphar.

**34** And Bacchides learned of this on the Sabbath day, and he came, he and all his army, across the Jordan.

**35** And Jonathan sent his brother as a leader of the company and entreated the Nabateans his friends to deposit with them their baggage, which was much.

**36** And the sons of Jambri came out from Medaba and seized John and all that he had and went away with it.

**37** After these things word was brought to Jonathan and Simon his brother that the sons of Jambri were celebrating a great wedding and were bringing the bride from Nadabath, the daughter of one of the great nobles of Canaan, with a great escort.

**38** And they remembered the blood of John their brother, and they went up and hid themselves under cover of the mountain.

**39** And they lifted up their eyes and looked, and behold a tumult and much baggage; and the bridegroom came out with his friends and his brothers to meet them with timbrels and musicians and many weapons.

**40** And they rose up against them from their ambush and killed them, and many fell wounded, and the rest fled into the mountain, and they took all their spoils.

**41** And the wedding was turned into mourning and the voice of their music into lamentation.

**42** And they avenged the blood of their brother, and returned to the marshes of the Jordan.

**43** And Bacchides heard and came on the Sabbath day to the banks of the Jordan with a great force.

**44** And Jonathan said to those with him: "Let us rise up now and fight for our lives, for it is not today as yesterday and the day before.

**45** For look, the battle is before us and behind us, and the water of the Jordan on this side and on that side, and marsh and thicket — there is no place to turn aside.

**46** Now therefore cry to heaven that you may be delivered from the hand of your enemies."

**47** And the battle was joined, and Jonathan stretched out his hand to strike Bacchides, but he turned away from before him.

**48** And Jonathan and those with him leaped into the Jordan and swam across to the other side, and they did not cross the Jordan against them.

**49** And there fell from Bacchides' side on that day about one thousand men.

**50** And he returned to Jerusalem and built strong cities in Judah: the fortress in Jericho and Emmaus and Beth-horon and Bethel and Timnath and Pharathon and Tephon, with high walls and gates and bars.

**51** And he set a garrison in them to harass Israel.

**52** And he fortified the city of Beth-zur and Gazara and the citadel, and he put forces in them and stores of food.

**53** And he took the sons of the leading men of the land as hostages and placed them under guard in the citadel in Jerusalem.

**54** In the one hundred and fifty-third year, in the second month, Alcimus commanded them to pull down the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary, and he pulled down the works of the prophets. And he began to pull it down.

**55** At that time Alcimus was struck, and his works were hindered, and his mouth was stopped and he was paralyzed, and he could no longer speak a word or give orders concerning his house.

**56** And Alcimus died at that time in great torment.

**57** And Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead, and he returned to the king, and the land of Judah was quiet for two years.

**58** And all the lawless men took counsel, saying: "Behold, Jonathan and those with him are dwelling in quiet and confidence. Now therefore let us bring Bacchides, and he will seize them all in one night."

**59** And they went and consulted with him.

**60** And he arose to come with a great army, and he sent letters secretly to all his allies who were in Judah, that they should seize Jonathan and those with him. But they were not able to do it, for their plan became known to them.

**61** And those of the men of the land who were the ringleaders of the mischief — Jonathan and those with him seized about fifty of them and killed them.

**62** And Jonathan and Simon and those with him withdrew to Bethbasi in the wilderness, and he built up what had been thrown down of it and made it strong.

**63** And Bacchides knew it, and he gathered all his company and notified those in Judah.

**64** And he came and encamped against Bethbasi and fought against it many days and made engines of war.

**65** And Jonathan left Simon his brother in the city and went out into the countryside, and he went with a force.

**66** And he struck Odomera and his brothers and the sons of Phaseron in their tent, and they began to strike and to go up with the forces.

**67** And Simon and those with him came out of the city and burned the engines of war.

**68** And they fought against Bacchides, and he was crushed by them, and they afflicted him greatly, for his plan and his march were in vain.

**69** And he was greatly angry with the lawless men who had counseled him to come into the land, and he killed many of them, and he purposed to return to his own land.

**70** And Jonathan learned of it and sent ambassadors to him to make peace with him and to give back to him the prisoners.

**71** And he received this gladly and acted according to his words, and he swore to him that he would do him no injury all the days of his life.

**72** And he gave back to him the prisoners he had taken before in the land of Judah, and he turned and departed to his own land, and he came no more into their borders.

**73** And the sword ceased from Israel, and Jonathan dwelt at Michmash and began to judge the people, and he destroyed the godless ones from Israel.
